allowed: OMRON Korean-language official catalogs supplied or downloaded from OMRON Korea
omronSourcePolicy.currentE3TBaseline: OMRON Korea official website + E3T Korean General Catalog 2010
omronSourcePolicy.updateRule: When a newer Korean official catalog is provided, compare document versions first; preserve prior evidence and update model/spec/lifecycle fields with source-version history.
omronSourcePolicy.recommendationRule: Models whose current lifecycle is not verified must not be default recommendations.
omronSourcePolicy.currentEESX4767Baseline: User-supplied OMRON Korean official EE-SX47/67 Catalog 2010

handoffRule: Any future chat/AI continuing this project should read PROJECT_HANDOFF.md and data/source-policy.json before modifying product data or recommendation logic.

uiPolicies.forkShapeImageHelp: EE-SX47/67 8 shape choices must show an official Korean catalog image by hover on desktop and tap on touch devices.
uiPolicies.noInertFilters: Do not show selectable filter controls that are not connected to selection logic.
